title: Included Tow Miles by Fulfillment Method — Trade-In Agreements
content:
The included tow miles on a **Trade-In Agreements** tow depend on the fulfillment method of the delivery appointment, under **Delivery & Pickup Appointments**, of the purchase the trade is applied to.

| Fulfillment method of that delivery appointment | Included tow miles |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | 60 |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | 40 |
| Any other method, or no delivery | The standard included tow miles; no enlarged allowance |

Miles of the tow distance up to the included tow miles are not charged; only the miles beyond them are.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- One-way distance 55 miles, Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery: all 55 miles fall within the 60 included miles, so none are charged on a one-way basis.
- One-way distance 55 miles, Kestrel Local Home Delivery: 15 miles beyond the 40 included miles.
- One-way distance 55 miles, Kestrel Hub Pickup: no enlarged allowance applies.
